title: Grateful Dead Live at Pelletier Farm on 1969-08-23

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of a nostalgic show that delivers a spooky, gong‑filled Dark Star and wild Love Light jam, plus a solid Merle Haggard cover.
ai_review.review: Listeners rave about the performance, especially the eerie, space‑laden Dark Star and the high‑energy Love Light improvisation. The organ work sparks debate over whether Pigpen or Tom was on keys, adding to the show’s historic charm. Recording quality is assumed solid as a soundboard source, with no complaints reported.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are 4‑5 stars and praise the musical moments; recording is a soundboard source with no negative technical notes, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific audio issues mentioned; reviewers focus on performance rather than sound problems.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is remembered for its deep, spooky space in Dark Star and the high‑octane jamming on Love Light, creating a compelling arc that keeps listeners engaged.

band_member_comments.Keys: Organ presence debated – some think Pigpen (Ron) while others suspect Tom Constanten.
